title: Mobile AI-Assisted Oral Lesion Triage for Community Oral Cancer Screening: Prospective Field Evaluation Study.
summary: A locked mobile AI system was tested prospectively in community oral-cancer screening; expert adjudication showed limited positive predictive value for red high-risk triage, with stronger yellow-category performance.
ai_technology: Methods describe prospective deployment and expert reference; Results report lesion-level red/yellow/green triage performance.
